description: Contract and diagnostics vocabulary for the proposed unchanged-project desktop runtime. No integrated runtime or target is certified.

features.reason: Rust-hosted WebGPU scenes and native Metal presentation are verified in bounded experimental profiles. The complete unchanged-project desktop profile and other target hardware remain unverified.
Experimental Node/ANGLE reference renders on Metal with known API failures; Rust bindings and native composition are not implemented.
Native Canvas 2D and texture upload are not implemented.
Bounded live DOM, React DOM, focus and event behavior is implemented in experimental profiles. General browser semantics, forms, lifetime and arbitrary project compatibility remain incomplete.
Native style, layout, text and GPU painting are integrated experimentally. Known clipping, layout, animation and broader paint gaps prevent declaring this complete profile supported.
Native frame scheduling and input delivery have bounded execution evidence; complete browser event-loop, lifecycle and hardware behavior for unchanged projects remains unverified.
Module workers and messaging in the shipping host are not implemented.
Candidate JS engines expose Wasm, but the selected host, loading and threading behavior have not been evaluated.
Application origin, storage and reload behavior are not implemented.
Shipping-host fetch and resource/origin semantics are not implemented.
Shipping-host WebSocket and external-service configuration are not implemented.
Web Audio and AudioWorklet host integration are not implemented.
WebRTC, microphone capture and recording are not implemented.
Native gamepad mapping and physical device checks are not implemented.
